generation_inputs.preparation: Exact 32x nearest-neighbour enlargement of native 24x24 PNG, without recolouring or aspect correction.

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: Historyline 1914–1918 original Amiga road-bend terrain redraw study.
Input image: edit target, a nearest-neighbour 32x enlargement of the verified original 24x24 PARTS:SSTRE114 tile, with transparent corners. Redraw THIS specific image with restrained modern illustrated surface detail. The native-size result must resemble this exact original about 90%.
Composition invariants: square canvas; hex fills canvas, with short flat top/bottom edges across middle third and pointed left/right at mid-height. Keep the road EXACTLY in the reference position and width: a wide flat medium-grey paved strip entering the upper-right sloping edge and bending down to the bottom-centre edge. Keep the exact count/positions of the tiny white road markings, brown shoulder strips and olive/lime grassy ground patches. Match the low-frequency colour masses; preserve saturated yellow-olive greens, flat medium grey pavement, brown earth, sparse white dashes. Preserve all landmarks and boundary intersections.
New detail: subtle fine grass blades and minute pavement grain painted ONLY inside the existing material regions. Detail should average back to reference colours at 24x24. Camera is the reference's map view; no added perspective/depth, raised road, new shading gradients, bevels or outline.
Output one isolated square terrain tile, full bleed to the same hex bounds with genuinely transparent outside corners. No surrounding frame, cast shadow, labels, text, extra roads, trees, rocks, cracks, objects or orange centre line. Avoid a border or dark rim; retain the original geometry and pavement width. This is an unapproved study.
cleanup: Generated source retained without pixel edits. tools/art-review makes alpha-weighted area reductions and clips to exact original coverage. It caps alpha, preserves candidate holes and does not repair semi-transparent interiors. Intrinsic native density only; no display-aspect or world-spacing correction.
review: See docs/art/connected-terrain-pilot.md. Assistant review is preliminary; source geometry, opacity, palette/markings and eventual joins need cleanup. No 90/100 approval or runtime port mapping.
determinism: AI reruns are not assumed deterministic; exports reproduce locally from retained source using tools/art-review.
